item.title: Pretty setting! Love the long driveway! Almost four acres in Kentucky. $345,970
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! I love the long driveway! The house was built in 1859. It is located on 3.78 acres in Horse Cave, Kentucky. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, really wide baseboards, picture rails, original mantels, spacious kitchen, office and a loft area. There is a detached garage on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,255 square feet. $345,970 Contact Erica Puckett with Legacy Property Group: 270-528-6965 From the Zillow listing: Country Liv

item.title: Beautiful landscaping! Pretty house! C. 1890 in Louisiana. $425,000
item.description: This house has beautiful landscaping! The interior is pretty and I love the porch. They have a build date of 1930, but it looks 1890. It is located in Madisonville, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, a picket fence, wood floors, crown moulding, picture rails, wide baseboards, original fretwork, pretty mantels, bead board ceilings, vintage light fixtures, updated kitchen, wainscoting and updated bathrooms. There is beautiful landscaping, brick walkways and a large back deck. Two

item.title: On 44 acres in Maine! Love the greenhouse! C. 1939. $239,000
item.description: Nice acreage with this house! I love that greenhouse! The home was built in 1939. It is located on 44 acres in Burlington, Maine. The house could use some updating, but it has some nice features to work with. The home features a large deck, a large great room with vaulted ceiling, wood floors and a built-in corner cabinet. There is a pretty greenhouse and an old barn on the property. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,800 square feet. $239,000 Contact Acres Away From the Zillow listing: Set alon

item.title: TWO houses. Pretty landscaping! “Dogwood Slopes”, C. 1948 in North Carolina. $389,000
item.description: This house has pretty landscaping! Love the enclosed front porch! There is a second home on the property. Dogwood Slopes was built in 1948. This is the first time it has been offered by the original family. It is located on .7 acre in Candler, North Carolina. The house features beautiful landscaping, an enclosed front porch, knotty pine, a side porch, wood floors, brick fireplace, wainscoting, den with stone fireplace and exposed beams. There is a second home on the property and a two car garage

item.title: Private setting! Three acres in Virginia. C. 1947. $185,000
item.description: Really private setting! Move in ready! The house was built in 1947. It is located on three acres in Keysville, Virginia. The house features a covered back deck, arched entryway, baseboards, updated bathroom, brick fireplace, tongue and groove walls in den and an updated kitchen. Updated mechanical systems. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,034 square feet. $185,000 Contact the property owner: 434-390-1739 From the Zillow listing: Move-In Ready Ranch-Style Home on 3 Private Acres – Keysville / C

item.title: Porch goals! Circa 1919 in Maryland. $389,000
item.description: Porch goals! What a great space that is! The house was built in 1919. It is located on .44 acre in Trappe, Maryland. The house features a large wrap around front porch, a screened in porch, wood floors, beautiful front door, nice staircase, baseboards, pocket doors, brick fireplace, vintage light fixtures and a spacious kitchen. There are a couple of detached storage buildings. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,446 square feet. $389,000 Contact Donna Harrington with Coldwell Banker Realty: 443

item.title: Riverfront in Massachusetts! Big kitchen! Over one acre. $349,000
item.description: Riverfront in Massachusetts! The home is situated on the banks of the North Branch of the Hoosac River. The house was built in 1920. It is located on 1.6 acres in Clarksburg, Massachusetts. The house features a large covered front porch, spacious kitchen, wood floors, wainscoting and exposed beams. The backyard is fenced. There is a detached storage shed and a detached garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,335 square feet. $349,000 Contact Erin M. Smith with Burnham Gold Real Estate: 413-28

item.title: Doll in basement is odd! Secluded property. Almost five acres in Michigan. $275,000
item.description: The doll in the basement is a bit odd! This house looks very secluded. Perfect getaway spot! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 4.86 acres in Cedar, Michigan. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, exposed beams, exposed brick and knotty pine. The cabin needs work to be completed. There are a couple of outbuildings on the property. item.description: This is a pretty house! Love that porch! It reads like the antiques are included. Those beds are really pretty! This house is known as Rosemont. It was built in 1907. It is located on .42 acre in Aberdeen, Mississippi. item.title: Nice woodwork! Almost three acres in Mississippi. $169,000
